summary: Centessa Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K announcing the expiration of the HSR Act waiting period for its acquisition by Eli Lilly. The deal, structured as a court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement under UK law, values Centessa at an undisclosed price per share. Expiration of the HSR waiting period satisfies one condition; closing remains subject to shareholder approval and High Court sanction. The transaction was announced March 31, 2026, per the Transaction Agreement with Lilly and LDH XV Corporation. No premium, advisor, or break fee disclosed. Watch for shareholder vote and court sanction timeline.
